short_notes:
‣ New Grok 4.5 model!
‣ New per-chat Reasoning Effort settings!
‣ 21 new Grok voices in Audio Generation!
‣ Other bug fixes and improvements
long_notes:
Hi everyone! This update adds full support for Grok 4.5, xAI’s new flagship model! Grok 4.5 brings stronger reasoning and performance, and it also supports the reasoning.effort parameter (Low / Medium / High reasoning).

Because most chat models now support reasoning effort, I also completely reworked the reasoning system. You will no longer be interrupted with reasoning prompts during conversations. Instead, you can now set the reasoning effort per chat through the Tool/Reasoning Settings menu for any model that supports it! The setting is saved with the chat and applied automatically.

I also significantly expanded the Audio Generation feature by adding 21 new Grok voices so you have more choices when generating speech!

As always, this update includes various bug fixes and small improvements throughout the shortcut.
I hope you enjoy the new update!
